data_fields.name: plain_say_cooldown_s
data_fields.donor_constant: none (no cooldown in donor; proposed 0.5 in sketch)

best_idea: One chat gate per channel group (cooldown keyed by group, not typed alias), one recipients function shared by delivery and the who-can-hear preview, and a target name that must match exactly one player.
decision_why: Range-plus-veto delivery and the typed who-hears preview fit a phone-first MMO, but the donor's per-command cooldown key is bypassable and its only moderation layer is the FAdmin mute, so we keep the shape, fix the key and the mismatched preview, and build moderation rows through the one writer.
acceptance: A server test sends /, a, ooc within 1.5 s and asserts exactly one OOC line posts; two players named Bob make /pm bob post nothing with an ambiguous notice; a crouched listener at the 250-unit edge sees a preview list equal to the delivered list.
